metadata.evidence:
#### Eigen3

We use [Eigen3](http://eigen.tuxfamily.org) for almost any mathematical operation.
metadata.reason: Lists Eigen3 as a required dependency and states its mathematical role.

metadata.evidence:
#### OpenCV

We use [OpenCV](https://opencv.org/) to manipulate images (read/write/display) and to bootstrap the monocular system.
metadata.reason: Lists OpenCV as a required dependency and identifies its image-processing and bootstrapping roles.

metadata.evidence:
#### Ceres Solver

We use [Ceres Solver](http://ceres-solver.org) to perform the photometric bundle adjustment.
metadata.reason: Lists Ceres Solver as a required dependency for photometric bundle adjustment.

metadata.evidence:
#### Qt

We use [Qt](https://www.qt.io/) for GUI and visualization. Although Qt is required to compile the whole project in the current version, it is easy to remove it. DSM does not depend on Qt.
metadata.reason: Identifies Qt as the GUI and visualization dependency, while documenting its current build-time status.
